# Claire Dunmore

Nathan's younger sister. Lives four hours away with her husband and works full time as a hospital pharmacist manager. Shares Mom's care costs and the decisions about them; favors assisted living.

## How we work together

- Monthly family video call on the last Sunday, with Mom joining when she wants to; extra calls for decisions ([[family-care-call-2026-07-26]]).
- Claire pays 20% of paid care, the same as Nathan ([[how-should-moms-care-costs-be-split]]); reconciled quarterly in the [[mom-care-cost-split-sheet]].
- She is successor agent on Mom's power of attorney and healthcare proxy ([[who-acts-for-mom-if-nathan-cannot]]) and has her own copy of the [[moms-care-documents-index]]. She does not have portal proxy access; Mom offered, Claire declined for now.
- She visits about every six weeks for a weekend and took Mom for the nine days of our [[halvane-peaks-trip-2026|Halvane Peaks trip]] in 2026-07.
- Division of tasks: [[claire-and-nathan-care-roles]].

## Where we differ

Claire thinks Mom should move to [[wrenhollow-assisted-living-brochure-2026|Wrenhollow Assisted Living]], near enough to us and with staff on site at night. Her case, in her own email, is in [[claire-email-assisted-living-case-2026-07]]: the stairs, the nights alone, and her worry that we will only move Mom after a second fall. She agreed to the aide trial only with a firm review date (2026-11-02) and said on the call that she wanted her disagreement minuted. It is.

Nathan's view is that Mom has the right to choose and has chosen ([[mom-decides-where-she-lives]]). The disagreement is about timing and risk, not about who cares more; we try to write it down that way.

## Current threads

- Aide trial review on 2026-11-02.
- [[moms-housing-decision]] by 2027-03-31.
